licking-river-greenway-trails: The city’s current Trails overview describes a 2½-mile hiking route from Levassor Place to Randolph Park, with a parallel paved trail for only part of the way. Confirm which route segment meets your needs.
2½-mile-long hiking trail along the Licking River from Levassor Place to Randolph Park. A parallel paved trail runs part of the way.

The city’s September 2019 report says a pedestrian bridge installed in May 2018 carried the paved path over 16th Street at the floodwall opening. This is historical route information; current bridge and approach conditions are unverified.

On May 18, 2018, for example, Dudley Construction supplied a critical link to two parts of the Greenway, installing a metal pedestrian bridge to carry the paved path over 16 th Street at the cut in the floodwall that leads to the campus of painting contractor Rizzo Brothers Inc.
